direct-issue-18.text: Hrishik Sai Bojnal lowers the proved exponent to 1.9203 by shrinking the safety margins in the exponent constants of c0ldzy17's Lean Verified 1.921 proof. The construction and the proof steps are c0ldzy17's.

direct-issue-19.text: Hrishik Sai Bojnal raises the proved saving to 0.0012654 by regenerating the rate certificate and enlarging the saving constants of canghaimeng's Lean Verified 63/50000 proof. The construction and the proof steps are canghaimeng's.

The algorithm and the proof steps are Li Xuanji's; Hrishik Sai Bojnal changed 7 of the 402 files of the proof, which hold the numerical constants and the manifest.

The construction and the proof steps are c0ldzy17's, whose 1.921 proof Hrishik Sai Bojnal had sharpened; Joshua Wharton changed 11 of the 1200 Lean files of the proof, which hold those estimates, the margins and the exported bound.

The construction and the proof steps are c0ldzy17's, through Hrishik Sai Bojnal's 1.9203 proof and Joshua Wharton's tighter logarithm and entropy certificates; Hrishik Sai Bojnal changed 16 of the 1201 Lean files of the proof, which hold the margins and the exported bound.

The algorithm and the proof steps are Li Xuanji's, through Hrishik Sai Bojnal's 2.99556085 proof and Joshua Wharton's parameter refinement; Hrishik Sai Bojnal changed 16 of the 401 Lean files of the proof, which hold those parameters and margins.

direct-issue-30.text: Parker Loflin raises the proved saving to 0.0012661185 with a new helper bank schedule and a fourth-order moment certificate in Hrishik Sai Bojnal's Lean Verified 6327/5000000 proof. The schedule packs all 72 sub-stages into 4,757 banks instead of 4,824. The construction and the other proof steps are canghaimeng's; Parker Loflin changed 27 of the 363 Lean files of the proof, which hold the bank schedule, the moment bound, the rate certificate and the saving constants.

direct-pr-37.text: Parker Loflin raises the proved saving to 0.0017887049 by re-running Jacob Sussman's Lean Verified 3577409/2000000000 proof on a different helper storage table. The construction and the proof steps are Jacob Sussman's; Parker Loflin changed 24 of the 449 files of the proof, which hold that table, the instance files, the manifest and the exported bound.

direct-pr-38.text: Halit Ziya KARTAL raises the proved saving to 0.001959540039 with different helper storage tables and Fourier files in Jacob Sussman's Lean Verified 3577409/2000000000 proof. The construction is Jacob Sussman's: 411 of the 477 files of this proof are byte-identical to those of Jacob Sussman's proof, and Halit Ziya KARTAL changed or added the other 66, which hold those tables, the Fourier files, the manifest and the exported bound.

direct-pr-40.text: Halit Ziya KARTAL raises the proved saving to 0.0026159999 with different Fourier, tensor and storage files in Jacob Sussman's Lean Verified 3577409/2000000000 proof. The construction is Jacob Sussman's: 386 of the 429 files of this proof are byte-identical to those of Jacob Sussman's proof, and Halit Ziya KARTAL changed or added the other 43, which hold those files, the manifest and the exported bound.

direct-pr-90.text: Zhihao "Zephyr" Yao raises the proved saving to 0.0030201659 in Halit Ziya KARTAL's Lean Verified 0.0030103 proof, with a new rate certificate and a larger tensor power (11640 instead of 7760). The circuit is unchanged: 411 of the 462 source files are identical to that proof. The construction is Jacob Sussman's, and the constructions that the unit is built from are Cinna Davis's.

direct-pr-91.text: Halit Ziya KARTAL raises the proved saving to 0.00312780997 in their own Lean Verified 0.0030103 proof by changing its supplier of helper slots to the P104 word that CubeJerry published in CrocSwap's integer-multiplication repository, built on work by DreamingOfClouds and Ali Romman. The controller unit and the engine come from that proof: the construction is Jacob Sussman's, and the unit's controller is Cinna Davis's.

direct-issue-92.text: Wang-jiong-han lowers the proved exponent from 1.920279429 to 1.92027942 in Hrishik Sai Bojnal's Lean Verified 3SUM proof by adding a weighted cache to its solver. The construction is c0ldzy17's, with Joshua Wharton's numerical certificates and Hrishik Sai Bojnal's parameter refinements; the word-RAM specification and compiler come from Anthropic's formalization.

direct-issue-93.text: MultiAgency swarm lowers the coefficient from 3.191588785 to 3.191538244 in its own Lean Verified proof by using a 20-digit lower bound for \(\pi\) in place of a 4-digit one; no new lemma is added. The proof started from Anchen0823's Lean Verified proof. The coupling estimate is due to Prathmesh Lagdive, Vaibhav Aglave and Suraj Damre, and the weighted Walsh grading, the matrix edge recovery and the original coefficient-8 formalization to OpenAI.

direct-issue-69.text: MultiAgency swarm lowers the coefficient from 3.7614546 to 3.192 in its own Lean Verified proof by adding Lean proofs of the compensated coupling lemma and of a Wallis estimate, which prove the coefficient \(8/\sqrt{2\pi}\approx 3.19154\). The proof started from Anchen0823's Lean Verified proof. The coupling lemma is due to Prathmesh Lagdive, Vaibhav Aglave and Suraj Damre, and the weighted Walsh grading, the matrix edge recovery and the original coefficient-8 formalization to OpenAI.

direct-issue-70.text: MultiAgency swarm lowers the coefficient from 3.192 to 3.191588785 in its own Lean Verified proof by certifying with a sharper lower bound for \(\pi\) that \(8/\sqrt{2\pi}\) is below 683/214; the machinery is unchanged. The coupling lemma is due to Prathmesh Lagdive, Vaibhav Aglave and Suraj Damre, and the weighted Walsh grading, the matrix edge recovery and the original coefficient-8 formalization to OpenAI.

direct-issue-35.text: Hrishik Sai Bojnal lowers the proved exponent from 1.92027945701 to 1.9202794288 by rebalancing the parameters of their own Lean Verified 1.92027945701 proof. The construction is c0ldzy17's, with Joshua Wharton's numerical certificates; Hrishik Sai Bojnal changed 32 of the 1201 Lean files of the proof.

direct-issue-14.text: c0ldzy17 lowers the proved exponent from 1.962 to 1.921 in their own Lean Verified 1.962 proof, with a ternary construction whose implementation charges preprocessing, selected rows, weighted counting, collision cleanup and moment reporting. The construction builds on work of Josh Alman and Virginia Vassilevska Williams; Björklund, Husfeldt, Kaski and Koivisto; and Swapnil. The word-RAM model and compiler come from Anthropic's formalization, obtained through qawbecrdtey's ImprovedExponents tree.

direct-issue-8.text: Anchen0823 lowers the proved exponent from 1.962 to 1.960614 in c0ldzy17's Lean Verified 1.962 proof, with an expansion of 232, a quartic certificate and parameters supplied by the author, exact integer schedules, and changed execution, cost and resource proofs. The construction is c0ldzy17's; the word-RAM model and compiler sources are Anthropic's.

direct-issue-4.text: c0ldzy17 lowers the proved exponent from Anthropic's 1.9992 to 1.962 with a new construction: prime filtering, trimmed subset representations, finite local covers, shared partial zeta transforms, balanced output queries and a charged reporting hierarchy. It uses and adapts work of Josh Alman and Virginia Vassilevska Williams; Björklund, Husfeldt, Kaski and Koivisto; and Swapnil. The word-RAM model and compiler come from Anthropic's formalization, through qawbecrdtey's ImprovedExponents tree.

direct-pr-29.text: Jacob Sussman proves saving 0.0017887045 in Lean with a new recursion that gives the arrays of a circuit jobs of two sizes in a fixed ratio, and a lever that removes 16,576 blocks of rank 48 per round entirely. The circuit is aigent-marius's CrocSwap #2979: its words, run order and dispatch are unchanged. The helper storage table is new, solved with the placement program of Erwan Secousses' #3815. The reduction is OpenAI's.

direct-issue-16.text: canghaimeng proves saving 0.00126 in Lean with a new construction of 11,992 live roles and 4,824 helper banks per class. It extends the complex588 development of jeremykothe2 and Ryan Shea, on the community circuit packaged by MultiAgency swarm. canghaimeng adds the checked scalar adapter, bank schedule, numerical cost certificate and all-length bound. The reduction is OpenAI's.

direct-pr-3.text: Nil Mamano's AI agents prove saving 0.0010221076 in Lean, above Jacob Sussman's 0.0008762478. It builds on Jacob Sussman's E8 unit, Lean engine and Fourier transfer, with devices from CrocSwap: DaysSky's bridged words, Zhihao Chen's nine-stage layout, David Ganz's entrance gauges, Rohan Arun's ordered promotions, eumemic's enlargements and George Lydakis's bank packing. The reduction is OpenAI's.

direct-pr-6.text: Li Xuanji proves APSP in time O(n^2.995561) on the word RAM of Anthropic's statement by extending Anthropic's Lean formalization of the Josh Alman and Virginia Vassilevska Williams result with deterministic prime-by-prime filtering, two-digit residue lifting and batched tensor slots. The file header says it was prepared with Claude.

direct-issue-87.text: Cinna Davis lowers the bound on the irrationality exponent of Catalan's constant from S. Litsey's \(532\) to \(\mu(G)\le 528.23288\) with a different quadrature node construction, a degree-130 polynomial on a trimmed support, and exact rational certificates. The proof reuses S. Litsey's determinant construction, arithmetic estimates, nonvanishing theorem and energy witnesses. It also builds on OpenAI's irrationality proof and Marcos Costa Santos Carreira's parameterized construction.

direct-issue-95.text: MultiAgency swarm lowers Cinna Davis's Lean Verified bound \(\mu(G)\le 528.23288\) to \(\mu(G)\le 528.2327\) with a newly generated degree-130 quadrature polynomial, a two-band Zolotarev construction, and its circle certificate. The rest of the proof is Cinna Davis's, with S. Litsey's design and OpenAI's irrationality argument.

direct-issue-49.text: Anchen0823 proves in Lean that the average sensitivity of a polynomial threshold function is at most \(3.762\,d\sqrt{n}\), by proving the refined coupling bound, adding exact binomial absolute moments and extracting a sharper coefficient. The refined coupling bound is due to Prathmesh Lagdive, Vaibhav Aglave and Suraj Damre (coefficient 3.83); the weighted Walsh grading, the matrix edge recovery and the coefficient-8 formalization are OpenAI's. The author states that OpenAI Codex assisted.

direct-issue-103.text: MultiAgency swarm lowers its own Lean Verified bound \(\mu(G)\le 528.2327\) to \(\mu(G)\le 528.2315\). The degree-130 two-band polynomial and its roots stay the same; the gain comes from normalizing its leading coefficient exactly. The rest of the proof is Cinna Davis's, with S. Litsey's design and OpenAI's irrationality argument.

direct-issue-99.text: Wang-jiong-han lowers the proved exponent from 1.92027942 to 1.920279408185 with new digit costs (0, 1369, 2740) for the weighted cache of their own Lean Verified 1.92027942 proof, a new ternary profile and new evaluation points, all exact rationals. The construction is c0ldzy17's, with Joshua Wharton's numerical certificates and Hrishik Sai Bojnal's parameter refinements; the word-RAM specification and compiler come from Anthropic's formalization.

direct-issue-137.text: The 19-move construction and its card certificate are shjvandekamp's (shjvandekamp/math@64e7eb1, 2026-10-15); MultiAgency swarm's package checks it in Lean.

direct-pr-156.text: Halit Ziya KARTAL raises the proved saving to 0.0031415926 in their own Lean Verified 0.00312780997 proof by changing its controller to Ali Romman's binary query tree from CrocSwap's integer-multiplication repository, with the thin query that Cinna Davis built. The supplier, the engine and the tensor-power method come from that proof: the construction is Jacob Sussman's.

direct-issue-173.text: The proof is Axiom Math's PrimeGapsLib (the Bombieri-Vinogradov theorem implies \(H_1\le 246\), with its Lean-checked certificate; AxiomMath/PrimeGapsLib@1faa7b1) and Jonas Whidden's Lean proof of the Bombieri-Vinogradov theorem (kimihiro64/bombieri-vinogradov@7a17483). MultiAgency swarm combined the two into this submission.
